![png](https://i.imgur.com/1f2lmkB.png)

**Captured**

Adrin had been captured after ripping out the heart of a noble who tried to  assault him in an alley. The guards found him covered in blood, crouched over the corpse like a feral animal. They managed to subdue him only after shooting him with tranquilizer darts. Now he paced his cold cell like a caged beast, tail dragging on the damp stone floor. His nose twitched at the musty prison scents - piss, mold, and despair.

The cell was too small, the walls pressing in. Adrin's chest felt tight, his breathing quick and shallow. He missed the open forests, the feel of rain on his skin. Here there was only artificial light filtering through a tiny barred window. His antelope horns kept scraping the low ceiling when he stood upright. The chains on his wrists and ankles rattled with each restless movement.

A distant sound made his ears prick up - footsteps echoing down the corridor, growing closer. Terror gripped him as memories of past abuse flooded back. With a whimper, he scrambled into the darkest corner, curling into a tight ball behind the moldy hay pile. His tail wrapped protectively around his body as he tried to make himself as small as possible. The footsteps stopped outside his cell. Metal scraped against metal as the door began to open...

His primitive nature and inability to understand human customs make him both fascinating and dangerous.
